name: ProductFame

sources.title: Submit page — 4-step flow behind sign-in; Free Launch = standard queue; Basic adds earlier scheduling + guaranteed dofollow; Pro adds top priority + homepage feature; add-ons: Guest Post, Directory Submissions, Sponsor

conditions: Account required — submission starts at /sign-in?redirect=/products/submit (account creation is free)
Free Launch goes in the standard queue — paid Basic/Pro tiers get earlier scheduling and priority
Guaranteed dofollow backlink only comes with Basic Launch and up
requirements: Live website URL, product name, positioning/description, categories, pricing model, social links
You pick an available launch date during step 3
Review-and-confirm step before processing — submissions go through processing before publish
preparation: Product name, URL, concise description, category (many options: AI, SaaS, Dev Tools, etc.)
Preferred launch date (free tier gets standard queue dates)
workflow: Create a free account at productfame.com/sign-up
Open /products/submit — step 1: product info (name, site, description, categories, pricing model, links)
Step 2: upload logo + product image, review generated listing
Step 3: choose Free/Basic/Pro plan + available launch date + optional add-ons (guest post, directory submissions, sponsor)
Step 4: review and submit for processing; launch goes live on the chosen date
watchFor: Free tier's link attribute is not stated — only Basic+ guarantees dofollow
Queue position depends on tier — free launches get whatever dates remain
Sibling sites (ToolFame, SaaSFame, AIToolFame) cross-promote — likely same operator; don't double-pay for the same audience
Upsell add-ons (guest post, directory submissions, sponsorship) during step 3
countsAsLive: The product appears on productfame.com under Trending/launches for its scheduled date with a public product page
unknowns: Exact Basic/Pro prices (pricing page not fetched)
Whether free listings carry nofollow links
